grammar.pattern: 第- / 老- / 小-：前缀与语境
grammar.purpose: Distinguish order from a familiar surname address
grammar.explanation: 第三位成员 is ordinal. 老李 and 小李 can be familiar address forms before surnames; they do not prove a person is old or small, and are not automatically suitable for strangers. Names like 小林 may also be someone’s actual given name: ask instead of assuming a prefix. 第 is not used before every numeral phrase: 三位成员 counts people, 第三位成员 selects their order.

examples.py: dì sān wèi chéng yuán hái méi dào .
examples.en: The third member has not arrived.

examples.py: nǐ kě yǐ jiào wǒ xiǎo lǐ .
examples.en: You may call me Xiao Li.

examples.zh: 老李是熟人之间的称呼。
examples.py: lǎo lǐ shì shú rén zhī jiān de chēng hū .
examples.en: Lao Li is a form of address among familiar people.

commonMistakes.wrong: 三位成员就是第三位成员。
commonMistakes.right: 三位成员是人数，第三位成员是顺序。

grammar.purpose: Recognize a suffix without replacing a word’s lexical meaning
grammar.explanation: 朋友们 marks a group; 桌子 has neutral zi, 里头 commonly neutral tou, and 科学家 denotes a practitioner. 画儿 may use rhotic huàr rather than an extra ér syllable. Some forms are lexicalized: 母亲中的亲 is not one of these suffixes. 三个朋友 does not normally become 三个朋友们. Do not attach each suffix freely or treat every final 家 as a role suffix; 我家 means my home.

examples.py: péng you men xiān kàn míng dān .
examples.en: The friends look at the list first.

examples.py: bāo lǐ tou méi yǒu míng dān .
examples.en: There is no list inside the bag.

examples.py: tā xiǎng chéng wéi kē xué jiā .

lines.zh: 你好，我姓李，叫我小李就行。
lines.py: nǐ hǎo , wǒ xìng lǐ , jiào wǒ xiǎo lǐ jiù xíng .
lines.en: Hi, my surname is Li. Just call me Xiao Li.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 你是上周来过的那位？我认得你的声音。
lines.py: nǐ shì shàng zhōu lái guò de nà wèi ? wǒ rèn de nǐ de shēng yīn .
lines.en: Were you here last week? I recognise your voice.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 对，不过你当时坐在里面，我们没说上话。
lines.py: duì , bù guò nǐ dāng shí zuò zài lǐ miàn , wǒ men méi shuō shàng huà .
lines.en: Yes, but you were sitting inside and we didn't get to talk.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 那今天坐这儿吧，我帮你留个位子。
lines.py: nà jīn tiān zuò zhèr ba , wǒ bāng nǐ liú gè wèi zi .
lines.en: Sit here today, then. I'll save you a seat.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 谢谢。刚才门口那位男子也是组里的成员吗？
lines.py: xiè xiè . gāng cái mén kǒu nà wèi nán zi yě shì zǔ lǐ de chéng yuán ma ?
lines.en: Thanks. Is the man at the entrance a member too?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 是，大家叫他老王。他来得最早，连门口的猫都认得他。
lines.py: shì , dà jiā jiào tā lǎo wáng . tā lái de zuì zǎo , lián mén kǒu de māo dōu rèn de tā .
lines.en: Yes, we call him Lao Wang. He comes so early even the cat outside knows him.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 猫也来参加？
lines.py: māo yě lái cān jiā ?
lines.en: Does the cat join in too?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 不，它只来吃东西。你家乡在哪里？
lines.py: bù , tā zhǐ lái chī dōng xi . nǐ jiā xiāng zài nǎ lǐ ?
lines.en: No, it's only here for food. Where's your hometown?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 在南方。我父母还住在那里。
lines.py: zài nán fāng . wǒ fù mǔ hái zhù zài nà lǐ .
lines.en: In the south. My parents still live there.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我母亲也是南方人，下次你们可以聊聊。
lines.py: wǒ mǔ qīn yě shì nán fāng rén , xià cì nǐ men kě yǐ liáo liáo .
lines.en: My mother's from the south too. You could chat next time.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 好。今天还有谁没到？
lines.py: hǎo . jīn tiān hái yǒu shéi méi dào ?
lines.en: Sure. Who hasn't arrived today?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 第三位新成员还在路上，我们先拿书。
lines.py: dì sān wèi xīn chéng yuán hái zài lù shàng , wǒ men xiān ná shū .
lines.en: The third new member is still on the way. Let's get the books first.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: A note for newcomers
reading.blurb: An original scene written for this course.
reading.purpose: Follow the situation, the problem and what happens next.

lines.zh: 我第二次去读书小组，刚到门口就有人叫小李。我一开始没反应过来，才想起上周自己说可以这样称呼。
lines.py: wǒ dì èr cì qù dú shū xiǎo zǔ , gāng dào mén kǒu jiù yǒu rén jiào xiǎo lǐ . wǒ yī kāi shǐ méi fǎn yìng guò lái , cái xiǎng qǐ shàng zhōu zì jǐ shuō kě yǐ zhè yàng chēng hū .
lines.en: On my second visit to the reading group someone called out Xiao Li at the entrance. It took me a moment to remember I'd suggested that name last week.

lines.zh: 陈宇认得我的声音，给我留了一个位子。这次我坐在中间，刚坐下就和旁边两位成员聊了起来。
lines.py: chén yǔ rèn de wǒ de shēng yīn , gěi wǒ liú le yī gè wèi zi . zhè cì wǒ zuò zài zhōng jiān , gāng zuò xià jiù hé páng biān liǎng wèi chéng yuán liáo le qǐ lái .
lines.en: Chen Yu recognised my voice and saved me a seat. This time I sat in the middle and started chatting with the two members beside me as soon as I sat down.

lines.zh: 门口的男子是老王，他已经参加小组两年了。他每次都早到，先开窗，再把书放到各张桌子上。
lines.py: mén kǒu de nán zi shì lǎo wáng , tā yǐ jīng cān jiā xiǎo zǔ liǎng nián le . tā měi cì dōu zǎo dào , xiān kāi chuāng , zài bǎ shū fàng dào gè zhāng zhuō zi shàng .
lines.en: The man by the entrance was Lao Wang. He'd been in the group for two years and always arrived early to open the windows and put books on the tables.

lines.zh: 一只猫跟着他进来，在椅子旁边坐下。陈宇说猫只认得带吃的来的人，老王说今天没带吃的，它也跟来了。
lines.py: yī zhǐ māo gēn zhe tā jìn lái , zài yǐ zi páng biān zuò xià . chén yǔ shuō māo zhǐ rèn de dài chī de lái de rén , lǎo wáng shuō jīn tiān méi dài chī de , tā yě gēn lái le .
lines.en: A cat followed him in and sat beside a chair. Chen Yu said it only knew people who brought food. Lao Wang pointed out that it followed him today even though he hadn't brought any.

lines.zh: 大家聊天时，我说自己的家乡在南方，父母还住在那里。陈宇说他母亲也是南方人，下次可能一起来。
lines.py: dà jiā liáo tiān shí , wǒ shuō zì jǐ de jiā xiāng zài nán fāng , fù mǔ hái zhù zài nà lǐ . chén yǔ shuō tā mǔ qīn yě shì nán fāng rén , xià cì kě néng yì qǐ lái .
lines.en: While we chatted I said my hometown was in the south and my parents still lived there. Chen Yu's mother was from the south too and might come with him next time.

lines.zh: 第三位新成员到了以后，我们才开始读书。回家时，我已经能叫出几位成员的名字，也和陈宇约好了下周再见。
lines.py: dì sān wèi xīn chéng yuán dào le yǐ hòu , wǒ men cái kāi shǐ dú shū . huí jiā shí , wǒ yǐ jīng néng jiào chū jǐ wèi chéng yuán de míng zi , yě hé chén yǔ yuē hǎo le xià zhōu zài jiàn .
lines.en: We began reading after the third new member arrived. By the time I left I could name several members and had arranged to see Chen Yu again the next week.

lines.zh: 门口那位姑娘是小李。
lines.py: mén kǒu nà wèi gū niáng shì xiǎo lǐ .
lines.en: The young woman at the entrance is Xiao Li.

lines.zh: 我向一位姑娘打听车站在哪里。
lines.py: wǒ xiàng yī wèi gū niáng dǎ tīng chē zhàn zài nǎ lǐ .
lines.en: I asked a young woman where the station was.

lines.zh: 这家店的老板是我的熟人。
lines.py: zhè jiā diàn de lǎo bǎn shì wǒ de shú rén .
lines.en: The owner of this shop is someone I know.

lines.zh: 到了活动现场，我看见了几个熟人。
lines.py: dào le huó dòng xiàn chǎng , wǒ kàn jiàn le jǐ gè shú rén .
lines.en: I saw a few people I knew at the event.

lines.zh: 她的衣服很有个性。
lines.py: tā de yī fú hěn yǒu gè xìng .
lines.en: Her clothes have an individual style.

lines.zh: 两个孩子的个性不一样。
lines.py: liǎng gè hái zi de gè xìng bù yī yàng .
lines.en: The two children have different personalities.

lines.zh: 他的性格很安静。
lines.py: tā de xìng gé hěn ān jìng .
lines.en: He has a quiet temperament.

lines.zh: 我们性格不同，却很聊得来。
lines.py: wǒ men xìng gé bù tóng , què hěn liáo de lái .
lines.en: Our personalities differ, but we get on well.

lines.zh: 这种小店常被称为夫妻店。
lines.py: zhè zhǒng xiǎo diàn cháng bèi chēng wéi fū qī diàn .
lines.en: This kind of small shop is often called a husband-and-wife shop.

lines.zh: 大家把这条路称为老街。
lines.py: dà jiā bǎ zhè tiáo lù chēng wéi lǎo jiē .
lines.en: Everyone calls this road the old street.

lines.zh: 我认得他，他以前住在这里。
lines.py: wǒ rèn de tā , tā yǐ qián zhù zài zhè lǐ .
lines.en: I know him; he used to live here.

lines.zh: 这个字你认得吗？
lines.py: zhè gè zì nǐ rèn de ma ?
lines.en: Do you recognise this character?

lines.zh: 她换了眼镜，我差点没认出她。
lines.py: tā huàn le yǎn jìng , wǒ chà diǎn méi rèn chū tā .
lines.en: She changed her glasses and I almost didn't recognise her.

lines.zh: 我一听声音就认出你了。
lines.py: wǒ yī tīng shēng yīn jiù rèn chū nǐ le .
lines.en: I recognised you as soon as I heard your voice.

lines.zh: 过年时，她回家看亲人。
lines.py: guò nián shí , tā huí jiā kàn qīn rén .
lines.en: She goes home to see her loved ones at New Year.

lines.zh: 他给远方的亲人写了一封信。
lines.py: tā gěi yuǎn fāng de qīn rén xiě le yī fēng xìn .
lines.en: He wrote a letter to relatives far away.

lines.zh: 老师很亲切，我有问题都敢问。
lines.py: lǎo shī hěn qīn qiè , wǒ yǒu wèn tí dōu gǎn wèn .
lines.en: The teacher is friendly, so I feel able to ask questions.

lines.zh: 听见家乡话，我觉得特别亲切。
lines.py: tīng jiàn jiā xiāng huà , wǒ jué de tè bié qīn qiè .
lines.en: Hearing my hometown dialect feels especially warm and familiar.

lines.zh: 周末我和父母一起吃饭。
lines.py: zhōu mò wǒ hé fù mǔ yì qǐ chī fàn .
lines.en: I eat with my parents at the weekend.

lines.zh: 他的父母都住在北京。
lines.py: tā de fù mǔ dōu zhù zài běi jīng .
lines.en: Both his parents live in Beijing.

lines.zh: 我的父亲喜欢种花。
lines.py: wǒ de fù qīn xǐ huān zhǒng huā .
lines.en: My father likes growing flowers.

lines.zh: 她的父亲今天来接她。
lines.py: tā de fù qīn jīn tiān lái jiē tā .
lines.en: Her father is coming to pick her up today.

lines.zh: 母亲给我寄了一件外套。
lines.py: mǔ qīn gěi wǒ jì le yī jiàn wài tào .
lines.en: My mother posted me a coat.

lines.zh: 她和母亲每晚通电话。
lines.py: tā hé mǔ qīn měi wǎn tōng diàn huà .
lines.en: She speaks to her mother on the phone each evening.

lines.zh: 她的两个子女都已经工作了。
lines.py: tā de liǎng gè zi nǚ dōu yǐ jīng gōng zuò le .
lines.en: Both her children are already working.

lines.zh: 这张表需要填写子女的姓名。
lines.py: zhè zhāng biǎo xū yào tián xiě zǐ nǚ de xìng míng .
lines.en: This form asks for the children's names.

lines.zh: 通知说员工可以带家属参加。
lines.py: tōng zhī shuō yuán gōng kě yǐ dài jiā shǔ cān jiā .
lines.en: The notice says employees can bring family members.

lines.zh: 家属在门口等他下班。
lines.py: jiā shǔ zài mén kǒu děng tā xià bān .
lines.en: His family are waiting outside for him to finish work.

lines.zh: 我的家乡在南方。
lines.py: wǒ de jiā xiāng zài nán fāng .
lines.en: My hometown is in the south.

lines.zh: 她给我们看了家乡的照片。
lines.py: tā gěi wǒ men kàn le jiā xiāng de zhào piān .
lines.en: She showed us photos of her hometown.

lines.zh: 离开故乡多年，他还是喜欢那里的菜。
lines.py: lí kāi gù xiāng duō nián , tā hái shi xǐ huān nà lǐ de cài .
lines.en: Years after leaving his hometown, he still likes its food.

lines.zh: 这首歌让她想起故乡。
lines.py: zhè shǒu gē ràng tā xiǎng qǐ gù xiāng .
lines.en: This song reminds her of her hometown.

lines.zh: 她年纪比我小，但经验比我多。
lines.py: tā nián jì bǐ wǒ xiǎo , dàn jīng yàn bǐ wǒ duō .
lines.en: She is younger than me but more experienced.

lines.zh: 他这个年纪还每天跑步。
lines.py: tā zhè gè nián jì hái měi tiān pǎo bù .
lines.en: At his age he still runs every day.

lines.zh: 一名男子在车站外等人。
lines.py: yī míng nán zi zài chē zhàn wài děng rén .
lines.en: A man is waiting for someone outside the station.

lines.zh: 这件外套是那位男子的。
lines.py: zhè jiàn wài tào shì nà wèi nán zi de .
lines.en: This coat belongs to that man.

lines.zh: 两名女子一起走进书店。
lines.py: liǎng míng nǚ zǐ yì qǐ zǒu jìn shū diàn .
lines.en: Two women entered the bookshop together.

lines.zh: 站在门边的女子正在打电话。
lines.py: zhàn zài mén biān de nǚ zǐ zhèng zài dǎ diàn huà .
lines.en: The woman standing by the door is on the phone.

lines.zh: 我和她的关系一直很好。
lines.py: wǒ hé tā de guān xì yì zhí hěn hǎo .
lines.en: She and I have always had a good relationship.

lines.zh: 这两条路有什么关系？
lines.py: zhè liǎng tiáo lù yǒu shén me guān xì ?
lines.en: How are these two roads connected?

lines.zh: 工作人员帮我们找座位。
lines.py: gōng zuò rén yuán bāng wǒ men zhǎo zuò wèi .
lines.en: A staff member helped us find seats.

lines.zh: 参加活动的人员请先到门口集合。
lines.py: cān jiā huó dòng de rén yuán qǐng xiān dào mén kǒu jí hé .
lines.en: People taking part should gather at the entrance first.

lines.zh: 我们小组有五位成员。
lines.py: wǒ men xiǎo zǔ yǒu wǔ wèi chéng yuán .
lines.en: There are five members in our group.

lines.zh: 新成员下周第一次来。
lines.py: xīn chéng yuán xià zhōu dì yī cì lái .
lines.en: The new member is coming for the first time next week.

audio.zh: 在南方。我父母还住在那里。
audio.py: zài nán fāng . wǒ fù mǔ hái zhù zài nà lǐ .
audio.en: In the south. My parents still live there.

tasks.statement: The hometown is in the south.
tasks.why: The heard line states this fact.

audio.zh: 第三位新成员到了以后，我们才开始读书。回家时，我已经能叫出几位成员的名字，也和陈宇约好了下周再见。
audio.py: dì sān wèi xīn chéng yuán dào le yǐ hòu , wǒ men cái kāi shǐ dú shū . huí jiā shí , wǒ yǐ jīng néng jiào chū jǐ wèi chéng yuán de míng zi , yě hé chén yǔ yuē hǎo le xià zhōu zài jiàn .
audio.en: We began reading after the third new member arrived. By the time I left I could name several members and had arranged to see Chen Yu again the next week.

tasks.statement: The narrator does not plan to return next week.
tasks.why: The heard line states a different outcome.

notes:
AI-assisted draft; native review pending. GF2021 grammar families: 三01, 三02. Native check: 第 order versus quantity, 老/小 surname address pragmatics, neutral suffixes 子/头/们 and erhua 儿, role 家 versus home, 熟人 register and family terminology. Fictional Li is glossed; no assumptions about real family or age. Native review pending. Planned retrieval 二35 / 二42 / 二36 / 二49 / 二50 / 二57: 喂，你好，有空的话来坐一会儿。, 不一会儿，她回了消息。, 先把面粉取出来，再称一百克。, 请她把杯子端出来。.
2026-10-07 parity editorial review: Early HSK 3 correction: warm introductions at a reading group, a hesitant reader taking a first turn, a one-hour volunteer handover and friends helping with messages and copying. Removed relationship-inference, unlimited-consent and assessment-policy cautions from ordinary speech. All 22 target records have two independent authored contexts, including formal or bound forms outside the casual scene. Preserved all old unit/word/task IDs. Native flags: 老王 and 小李 forms of address; bound 者/员 and 志愿 application sense; 怕是 cautious prediction; colloquial 留个位子/接班 and quiet cat/chair teasing; 没收到 méi shōu dào rather than 没收 mò shōu; warmth versus familiarity in 亲切; 亲 as blood relation or closeness. Check every factual key against its own heard line. Native review pending; no independent pronunciation or learner-mastery certification.
